about: A JavaScript plugin that turns Markdown into Word documents.

prs.title: Extra paragraphs in a list item stay inside that item
prs.broken: A numbered item with a second paragraph or a code block got each block numbered as its own item, so a two-item list came out as three in Word.
prs.changed: I made only the first block get the number, and indented the rest under the same item.
prs.matters: Lists in the Word file match the Markdown they came from.
